svg.aria-label: The six layer colours, the computed fill and the accent
svg.text: A protocol or a role has no colour of its own: it inherits its layer’s. Six hues, not 191. Light theme on top, dark below.
The badge fill is computed, not chosen
Every fill is set on the same luminance (0.87) and its chroma capped at 0.20, so no badge shouts louder than another.
One colour, reserved for “this is the subject of this diagram”. It is absent from the layer palette, the legend names it
separately, and it carries a thicker stroke — because under deuteranopia this magenta and the Files teal are the same colour.
#A3196F · 3.2 px, thicker than any normal stroke
